items.question: Can Allocate support multiple organizations in one workspace?
items.answer: Yes. The platform is designed for multi-tenant operations, so each organization keeps its own resources, policies, and billing state.

items.question: How do staff and org admins see different views?
items.answer: Roles control what each user sees. Org admins get oversight dashboards, while staff get focused queues, reminders, and their own bookings.

items.question: Can I block bookings during maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. Maintenance mode and availability rules can be applied before confirmation to keep resources safe and usable.

items.question: How are credits and subscriptions tracked?
items.answer: Balances, top-ups, and subscription status stay attached to the organization so finance and operations can review the same data.

about.title: About Allocate
about.subtitle: We are building an operations platform that helps teams make clear decisions instead of managing scheduling chaos.
about.storyBody: Allocate began with one repeated pain: scheduling, resource, and staffing data lived in disconnected tools. We built a command center where every operational decision can be fast, visible, and reliable.
values: Operations first: beautiful interfaces that solve real execution work
Visibility by default: real-time signal on bookings, capacity, and team status
Scale without friction: same confidence from small teams to enterprise orgs
about.missionBody: Turn scheduling into a strategic capability so every team can execute with confidence from planning to delivery.

problem.title: Teams needed one system to manage bookings, usage, billing, refund credits based on availability and notifications
paragraphs: Organizations were switching between booking tools, chat threads, and billing spreadsheets just to keep work moving.
That created duplicated effort, unclear accountability, and too much time spent verifying whether a room, desk, or resource was actually available.
Allocate was shaped to remove that friction by keeping every operational signal in one workspace.
